description.value: Ajisai Sushi Bar is a long-running traditional Japanese sushi restaurant on West 42nd Avenue in Vancouver's Kerrisdale neighbourhood, offering dine-in lunch and dinner as well as telephone takeout. The restaurant is known for a focused menu of nigiri, sashimi, chirashi, and donburi made with high-quality seafood. A sister grab-and-go outlet, Ajisai 2 Go, operates next door at 2087 W.42nd Ave with ready-made rolls and bento for cyclists who want a quick stop.
